_notes.tileOrientation: Rows top to bottom, columns left to right, with the tile's letter in the lower-left corner (boardgamehelpers.com lettering). Tiles are 6x6 and are placed in any of 4 rotations.
sources: God cards: ultraboardgames.com/the-great-zimbabwe/the-gods.php and onlineboardgamers.com card images
Technology and specialist cards: onlineboardgamers.com screenshots

mapLayouts._comment: Tile slots on a 3x3 tile grid; '*' is the start tile, 'x' a random tile, '-' empty. From the rulebook's setup diagrams.

rainCeremony.effect: Place one 2x1 water tile on empty land.

shaman.effect: Place one resource tile on empty land.

builder.effect: This turn, the first 2 cattle of each craftsman you build are paid to this card (returned at revenue).

herd.effect: Pay 2 to gain 1 cattle from the stock (onto the card); at most 3 times per turn.

nomads.effect: Ignore the zoning restriction when building a new monument this turn.

shadipinyi.effect: Extra plaque at the front of the bidding queue; its cattle go to this player.

elegua.effect: Up to 3 cattle of the first gift each round are paid from the common stock.

dziva.effect: At the start of your turn, may raise and/or lower prices on your technology cards.

eshu.effect: Transport range 6 instead of 3 (craftsmen also reach range 6 during this player's turn).

gu.effect: Each technology card costs only 1 VR (retroactive rebate).

obatala.effect: Build-a-monument action places two monuments instead of one.

atete.effect: May use each resource a second time.

tsuiGoab.effect: Ritual goods for a raise need not be different types.

anansi.effect: Pays only 1 cattle per ritual good regardless of price.

qamata.effect: All hub payments by any player go to this card instead of the stock.

xango.effect: No special power; wins ties at end of game.
